   211	    if len(set(services)) != len(services):

   282	def _prefix_function(pattern):
   283	    """KMP failure function over a token pattern."""
   284	    size = len(pattern)
   285	    table = [0] * size
   286	    for position in range(1, size):
   287	        shift = table[position - 1]
   288	        while shift > 0 and pattern[position] != pattern[shift]:
   289	            shift = table[shift - 1]
   290	        if pattern[position] == pattern[shift]:
   291	            shift += 1
   292	        table[position] = shift
   293	    return table
